release_title: Japanese Generative AI Technical Survey — 2026-W32 v0.2
notes: W32 was frozen before reproducible PDF timestamps were introduced; its exact release asset therefore comes from the already validated frozen Actions artifact.
The release workflow verifies the PDF SHA-256 against expected_pdf_sha256 before any Release is created or published.
The GitHub Release tag is a release-control anchor created from the current default branch at Draft creation time. It is not the authoritative pointer to the PDF-producing source tree.
The authoritative survey provenance is the pair of source_commit and expected_pdf_sha256 recorded here and repeated in RELEASE_METADATA.json attached to the Draft/Release.
Publication remains an explicit workflow_dispatch action after the human Freeze Gate.
